author: National Geographic
description:
Travel across the United States to follow along with Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) in their hunt to crack down on trafficking and smuggling. Featuring three, full episodes, this MEGA episode uncovers ketamine hidden in clothing, human remains in Halloween decorations, a marijuana ring, counterfeit pharmaceutical products, and illegal weapons operations. 

Flesh, Bones, Ketamine and Drones - 00:00
Customs and Border Protection in Philadelphia search packages coming from Europe and discover ketamine hidden in clothing and human remains manifested as Halloween decorations. U.S. Border Patrol surveil the Rio Grande River day and night with boats and drones to intercept smugglers bringing migrants across. Bono concludes his illustrious career with an official retirement at JFK.
